page.title: Settings
page.purpose: Own every preference: availability, appearance (Auto/Day/Night and transition hours), focus preferences, integrations, sharing management, notifications, data/portability, learning controls, and standard theme/font-scale/locale/accessibility options.

priorities.statement: Availability and protected time are explicit and never inferred from waking hours; changes preview their capacity effect before applying.
Appearance settings (Auto policy, editable Day/Night transition hours, reduced scenery, art-free, subdued night) are visible with their defaults and never alter scheduling data.
Learning controls show which data informs insights, accepted adjustments, and reset/exclusion; confidence language matches available evidence.
Integration and sharing management show connection health, granted scopes, and revocation with the real capacity/privacy effect explained.

states.description: Current preference values resolve from the profile.
Grouped settings rows render with current values.
An optional section (e.g. integrations, sharing) has nothing configured yet: explain what connecting adds and offer the action.
A section is partly configured (e.g. availability set but no reserve): show what remains and its planning effect.
A connection's health is stale: show last successful sync and a reconnect action.
A preference change is committing; the control shows a busy state and prevents duplicate submit.
An invalid value (e.g. overlapping availability rule) is rejected inline with the entered value preserved.
A save failed: input is preserved with a retry; the app never claims saved.
